ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 11 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers up to 30% off, yet 0 of 20 ads mention any offer, so a new buyer has no reason to act. Put the 30% off in the first line of three new ads, with SHIP125 on the creative.
Your site explains free shipping, yet 0 of 29 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a gift buyer wondering about arrival has to leave to find out. Lead three new ads with free shipping over $125.
Your site shows prices from $25 to $125, yet 0 of 29 ads mention price, so buyers have no number to compare. Lead one new ad with a price, such as $25, beside what a store charges.

None of your 29 live ads carries a proof number, so a first-time buyer has to trust the design alone. Collect one number, such as orders shipped or average rating, and lead three new ads with it on the creative.
